public_comment.speaker: John Rabbit
public_comment.stated_role: former member of the Board of Assessors
public_comment.topic: Chapter 41A tax deferral program for seniors
public_comment.quote: john rabbit, 314 townsend harbor road, a former member of the board of assessors, raised awareness of the town's chapter 41a tax deferral program for seniors. mr. rabbit noted that the program, which allows qualifying seniors to defer property tax payments at a 4% interest rate for as long as they own their home, is currently not prominently listed on the town's website.
